name: MC shout commands
desc: Hardstyle MC layer from shabda male TTS: 'heavyweight / pressure / thunder / voltage' barked between kicks, bit-crush alternating bars, delay throwing tails into the hall. Sparse drops one command per bar; peak stutter-chops with ply doubles. Groove survives if the TTS pack is still warming.

code.peak: s("<heavyweight pressure thunder voltage>").struct("x ~ [~ x] [~ x]").chop(4).ply("<1 2 1 1>").speed("<${pitch} 1.1 .9>").crush("<10 6>").hpf(180).shape(.25).delay(.35).delaytime(.23).delayfeedback(.4).room(.3).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.65, ${gain}).fast(4)).orbit(8).play()
